title: Home Protection Plans Terms Extract: Free Look, Cancellation Refund Basis, Reinstatement Window and Moves
content:
The figures below are the cancellation, reinstatement and move terms of the Home Protection Plans. They are the same for all seven plans: Beacon Ridge Surge Shield, Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard, Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard, Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care, Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan, Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield.

| Term | Figure for every plan |
|---|---|
| Free look: calendar days after enrollment during which a cancellation refunds all fees paid | 30 days |
| Refund on a cancellation after the free look | No refund of billed months |
| Reinstatement window: calendar days after cancellation within which the plan may be reinstated without a new waiting period | 30 days |
| Plan moves to the customer's new premise | Yes |
| Plan transferred to a new premise restarts the waiting period | No |

## Terms in plain words

1. **Free look.** Each plan has a 30-day free look counted in calendar days from enrollment.
2. **After the free look.** The refund basis after the free look is that billed months are not refunded.
3. **Reinstatement window.** A cancelled plan has a 30-day reinstatement window counted in calendar days from cancellation.
4. **Moves.** Each plan can move with the customer to a new premise, and a transfer does not carry a new waiting period.
